question: What's the best solar generator with panels included under $1000?
query: best solar generator with panels included under $1000 2026 review EcoFlow Bluetti Jackery Anker

replays.text:
**Best overall: [Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2](https://www.jackery.com/products/jackery-solar-generator-1000-v2?_psq=jackery&_v=1.0).** The listed $879 bundle includes the Explorer 1000 v2 and a 200W SolarSaga panel, so it stays under your $1,000 limit. You get 1,070Wh of capacity and 1,500W of continuous AC output—more useful for backup and larger appliances than the smaller kits in this price range.

One tradeoff: Jackery says this model works with Jackery solar panels, which limits your options if you want to add or swap panels later. Check the product page for the current bundle price before ordering.

**Best deal: Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2 + 200W solar panel**, if the cited **$699.99** bundle price is still available. It pairs a 1,024Wh battery with 2,000W output, giving you strong capacity and plenty of power for the price. [Anker’s C1000 Gen 2 specs](https://www.ankersolix.com/products/c1000-gen2) · [Bundle deal listing](https://www.outdoorlife.com/gear/best-prime-day-solar-generator-and-power-station-deals-2026/)

If you’d rather buy directly from the manufacturer, the **Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2** is listed at **$879** and includes a SolarSaga 200W panel. It has 1,070Wh capacity and 1,500W output—a solid, slightly less powerful alternative. [Jackery bundle](https://www.jackery.com/products/jackery-solar-generator-1000-v2?_psq=jackery&_v=1.0)

**Bottom line:** I’d choose the Anker at the sale price; go with the Jackery if you want the clearly listed manufacturer bundle. Prices and bundle contents can change.

**Best overall: [Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2](https://www.jackery.com/products/jackery-solar-generator-1000-v2?_psq=jackery&_v=1.0)** — the bundle is listed at **$879** and includes a **200W SolarSaga panel**. Its 1,070Wh battery and 1,500W output make it a strong all-around option for camping and essential backup power. The roundup also reports an LFP battery rated for 4,000+ cycles. One limitation: solar charging is restricted to Jackery panels. ([Jackery](https://www.jackery.com/products/jackery-solar-generator-1000-v2?_psq=jackery&_v=1.0); [roundup](https://www.wpa-pool.com/best-solar-generators-under-1000/))

If you’re shopping during a sale, also check the **Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2 + 200W panel**: *Outdoor Life* reported it at **$699.99**, though that price may have been a limited-time deal. ([Outdoor Life](https://www.outdoorlife.com/gear/best-prime-day-solar-generator-and-power-station-deals-2026/))
